comment: The README says the octave is preserved by transposing up or down depending which is closer. The code takes the fractional part of the total transposition and subtracts it, rather than its complement, whenever it is 0.5 or more, so a transposition of 7 semitones lowers the pitch by 7 semitones instead of raising it by 5. Bypassing the module passes each channel input straight to its channel output.
